title: data for rebrief.request
description: Owner asks the reviewers to QC the task and re-plan if needed (mode strategy, the default) or only to say continue or change course (mode qc), or to update the task's Now/Next text (mode status; it closes when the text changes). Recorded as an open owner feedback of kind rebrief plus a ping; the task shows it as pending until a plan is posted after it.
